messages:
maria: Morning — quick async standup: Kestrel (renewal customer) seeing intermittent 500s on webhook ingestion since ~02:00 UTC. I collected request IDs and logs, opened CS ticket #C-4821, added screenshots. Blocker: customers are seeing retries causing duplicates. Need an eng patch or routing change.

kevin: Sorry, saw alerts. I'm oncall — looking at logs now. Can you paste a couple request IDs? @jonathan fyi, might be related to the recent webhook consumer deploy.

maria: Thanks — sample IDs: req_7f3a, req_8a9d. I also toggled backoff to 3s on our side as a temp mitigation.

jonathan: Thanks. I rolled back the webhook-consumer canary 02:12 UTC but errors persisted. Looks like a DB retry storm on the dedupe service. I'll instrument a metric and PM patch to add idempotency header checks. ETA ~2h.

sarah: FYI renewal call for Kestrel at 16:00 PT. We should notify them of mitigation steps and ETA. Can we confirm no data loss? :worried:

jonathan: No data loss expected, just duplicates on retries. I'll add a small dedupe window and post an update in 30m. Re: notifying customer, please mention temporary increasing of dedupe TTL and the rollback; avoid technical detail.

maria: copied. I'll draft a short note for the renewal DM: "We're actively mitigating an ingestion spike causing duplicate events; we expect fix within 2 hours. No data loss; we will follow up when resolved." Share if OK.

kevin: Quick ask for ops — can eng increase TF autoscaler min for webhook-consumers to handle the burst? current min=2. bump to 4 for 1h? @eng-infra

opsbot: Incident Created — INC-2023-1789 — webhook-ingest-500s. Severity: P2. Assignees: jonathan, kevin. Timeline channel: #incidents.

jonathan: bumping min now, will monitor. Posting metrics link: https://metrics.redwood.example.com/d/q1/webhook-consumer?org=kestrel

maria: Thanks all. I'll send the renewal DM and update the CS queue. If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
